NewsArticle.Title: Religious Summoning
NewsArticle.Content: From the power of the Calling Stone, each religion learns to summon three creatures, some of which have never been seen in Temuair. Two of the creatures are very powerful. The dates for each religion were determined by that religion's success in The Entreaty: - Luathas ((99.09.22)) - Ceannlaidir, from the Goblins ((99.09.24)) - Deoch ((99.09.26)) - Fiosachd ((99.09.28)) - Sgrios ((99.09.30)) - Glioca ((99.10.02)) - Cail ((99.10.04)) - Gramail ((99.10.06)) Summoning is done by prayer and supplication or entreaty. The creature follows its summoner and attacks all creatures that attack its master. Each religion's creatures embody that religion. For examples, Fiosachd, the God of Luck's creatures are the swiftest; Ceannlaidir, the God of War's creatures inflict the most damage; Gramail, the God of Law's creature have magic resistance. Summoning does not always work; it may fail. The creature leaves the summoner after a few minutes. A summoning is just one of the 200+ unique miracles. The best three religions' worshippers that participated also received a legend of the event. Enter Dark Ages, and talk to a Shrine assistant in one of the eight shrines. Most shrines are found outside each village. Learn about [The Entreaty,](http://www.darkages.com/news/990918.html) [religion,](http://www.darkages.com/play/s_religion.html) [legends,](http://www.darkages.com/play/s_legend.html) and [many features](http://www.darkages.com/pics/index_feature.html) of Dark Ages.
